sup:70740.subject: 1.4404 bar dia 30 mm: price basis and AS-14404 clause, 36-month proposal
sup:70740.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your quotation. Thank you also for your letter of 22 September, in which you proposed agreeing the price basis for the coming period together with a price adjustment clause based on AS-14404. We agree that both should be settled together, and we would like to do so on a longer footing.

Our proposal for round bar 1.4404 dia 30 mm, peeled (DAP, 14-day lead time, valid from 1 January 2027):
- Unit price: EUR 4.60/kg
- Index clause: AS-14404, 45% material share, 0% deadband, base month 2026-08
- Payment: 30 days net
- Contract term: 36 months

This would cover our annual requirement of 23,700 kg for three years, rather than the 12 months in your quotation. That gives your planning a stable account with a firm price basis for the whole period. Under the clause, alloy movements from the August 2026 base would be handled transparently in both directions, so the base price itself can stay settled.

On the price level, our orders with you on 2 and 17 June 2026 were at EUR 5.26/kg (po:4500014022-10, po:4500014078-10). Our orders on 1 and 18 September 2026 were at EUR 5.84/kg (po:4500014355-10, po:4500014427-10). Your quoted EUR 6.10/kg would be a further step up from there, and we cannot support that for a new base that also includes index protection.

Does this package work for you? If it does not, please tell us which element needs adjusting and we will look at it constructively.

Kind regards,
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

sup:70740.subject: Re: 1.4404 bar dia 30 mm: price basis and AS-14404 clause, 36-month proposal
sup:70740.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. While we acknowledge the historical prices from your previous orders, our current cost structure necessitates an adjustment to the base price. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.

We welcome your proposal for a 36-month contract and the inclusion of the AS-14404 index clause, which provides long-term stability for both parties. Under these extended terms, we can offer a revised base price of EUR 5.40 per kg. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404.

To summarize, our Angebot stands at a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

sup:70740.subject: Round bar 1.4404 dia 30 mm - one complete package for the 36-month price basis
sup:70740.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your revised quotation and for confirming that the order-price history holds. We also appreciate that you welcomed the 36-month term and the AS-14404 clause. Settling the price basis and the adjustment clause together, as your September letter proposed, is the right approach for both sides.

We have moved from our opening EUR 4.60/kg to EUR 4.95/kg. In return we keep our full commitment: 23,700 kg per year for three years. That is a stable, predictable account for your planning over the whole period, with no annual renegotiation of the base.

Our proposal (DAP, 14-day lead time, valid from 1 January 2027, no tooling):
- Unit price: EUR 4.95/kg
- Index clause: AS-14404, 45% material share, 3% deadband, base month 2026-08
- Payment: 30 days net
- Contract term: 36 months

The 3% deadband is a new element of this proposed exchange, not something already agreed. A 3% band passes more of the alloy movement through to the price than a wider band would. That reduces how much alloy risk sits inside your base price, and it is why we can justify a lower starting price.

On the conversion side, the latest data also point downwards. PPI-C2431 changed by -2.27% from June to August 2026 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-06, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08). We recognise that this sits alongside the annual increase you described. It is one reason we see room for the base to settle below your quotation.

Could you confirm this complete package as your standing quotation? If one element does not work for you, please tell us which, and we will look at it constructively.

Kind regards,
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

sup:70740.subject: Re: Round bar 1.4404 dia 30 mm - one complete package for the 36-month price basis
sup:70740.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains. We have verified the recent short-term decrease in PPI-C2431 and have incorporated this into our pricing model. While this provides some relief, the broader annual cost increases still necessitate a sustainable base price.

Building on your proposed 36-month contract and the AS-14404 index clause, we are prepared to offer a revised unit price of EUR 5.20 per kg. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. Our complete offer consists of a price of €5.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

This offer is valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

sup:70740.subject: Round bar 1.4404 dia 30 mm – complete package for your binding quotation
sup:70740.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your revised quotation, and for adopting the 3% deadband within the AS-14404 clause. We now share the full structure: 36 months, 30 days net, and AS-14404 on a 45% material share with a 3% deadband and base month 2026-08. The remaining point is the starting price.

Our proposal (DAP, 14-day lead time, valid from 1 January 2027, no tooling):
- Unit price: EUR 5.00/kg
- Index clause: AS-14404, 45% material share, 3% deadband, base month 2026-08
- Payment: 30 days net
- Contract term: 36 months

We are moving from EUR 4.95 to EUR 5.00/kg, and our authorised 23,700 kg per year stays committed for the full three years. This involves no additional volume, exclusivity or monthly call-off schedule. It does give your planning a firm, predictable account over the whole term, which we understand matters as you focus on customers with volume.

The 3% deadband passes more of the alloy movement through to the price than a wider 5% band would, in both directions. That is the exchange we are proposing: more alloy pass-through via the clause, in return for a lower starting price. It does not remove every cost risk on your side. It does reduce the alloy risk that the base price itself needs to carry.

On the alloy side, AS-14404 changed by -5.49% from June to September 2026 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09). We recognise that this recent movement sits alongside the annual increase you described. Over the term, the clause will continue to reflect AS-14404 movements beyond the deadband from the August 2026 base.

Could you issue this complete package as your binding quotation? If something still stands in the way, please tell me what it is, and I will look at it with you constructively. I would like to settle the price basis and the clause together with you on a footing that works for both sides over the next three years.

Kind regards,
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

sup:70740.subject: Re: Round bar 1.4404 dia 30 mm – complete package for your binding quotation
sup:70740.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your ongoing partnership. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We have verified the recent decrease in AS-14404 from June to September 2026 and have factored this into our calculation. 

Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. Specifically, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains.

To ensure a sustainable base price over the entire 36-month term, we can offer a revised unit price of EUR 5.10 per kg. We are pleased to maintain the 30 days net payment terms and the AS-14404 index clause as agreed. 

Here is our Angebot: a price of €5.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.10 per unit, under a price of €5.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. This offer stays valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

proposal.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your revised quotation, and for taking the 5% deadband into the structure. We now share the full framework: 36 months, 30 days net, and AS-14404 on a 45% material share with a 5% deadband and base month 2026-08. The only open point is the starting price.

We propose one complete package:

- Unit price: EUR 5.04/kg
- Payment: 30 days net
- Contract term: 36 months
- Price adjustment: AS-14404, material share 45%, 5% deadband, base month 2026-08

We are moving from EUR 5.00 to EUR 5.04/kg. Our authorised 23,700 kg per year stays committed for the full three years.

On the alloy side, AS-14404 changed by -5.49% from June to September 2026 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09). We fully recognise that this recent movement sits alongside the annual increase you describe. Under the clause, alloy movements beyond the deadband will continue to adjust the price in both directions over the term. The starting price therefore does not need to carry a forecast of where alloy goes next.

The enquiry terms remain unchanged: 23,700 kg per year, DAP, 14-day lead time, prices valid from 1 January 2027, and no tooling. The commitment involves no additional volume, exclusivity or monthly call-off schedule.

Could you issue this complete package as your binding quotation? If something still stands in the way, please tell me exactly what. I would like to close this with you on a basis that works for both sides over the next three years.

Kind regards,
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your reply and for agreeing to the call. We would be glad to take up the walk-through of your calculation. Could you suggest two or three time slots? If it is easier, a short split of your price into material and conversion (as of base month 2026-08) by e-mail would serve the same purpose.

We understand that €5.60 is the rate you see for these conditions. Please also consider what has changed on our side since your first Angebot:
- We have accepted the AS-14404 Preisgleitklausel. From the 2026-08 base month onwards, you carry no further alloy risk.
- We have doubled the term from 12 to 24 months. That gives you secured volume of 47,400 kg.
- We have kept the 60-day Zahlungsziel.

Because the alloy risk now sits with the clause, the base price should reflect that. To meet you, we are moving up again and offering three alternatives. All are DAP, 14 days lead time, 23,700 kg per year and effective 1 January 2027:

| Package | Price | Zahlungsziel | Term | Index clause (AS-14404, 45% material share, base 2026-08) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | €5.50/kg | 60 days | 24 months | 5% deadband |
| B | €5.45/kg | 60 days | 24 months | 3% deadband (your structure) |
| C | €5.46/kg | 60 days | 36 months | 5% deadband |

- **Package A** is within 2% of your current figure. We understand it could therefore be settled without waiting for your pricing committee.
- **Package B** keeps exactly the clause you proposed.
- **Package C** gives you three years of volume security, which we understand matters to you as you focus on customers with volume.

Could you let us know which package you can confirm, or which one you would like to finalise on the call? We would like to close this well before the current contract ends on 31 December 2026.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for building on Option A. We appreciate your team keeping the 36-month term, the AS-14404 clause with a 5% deadband and the 30-day payment, and the movement you have made on price.

Since we now seem aligned on the structure, the remaining difference is the price. For your review, AS-14404 changed by -5.49% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09). We recognise that this recent window can coexist with the annual increase you described. The proposed clause would continue to reflect AS-14404 movements beyond the deadband over the contract term.

Could you kindly review whether you can approve Option A as your binding offer? Option A is EUR 5.07/kg, payment within 30 days net, a 36-month contract, AS-14404 on a 45% material share, 5% deadband and base month 2026-08. The fixed terms of our enquiry stay unchanged. If the price is what prevents approval, could your pricing committee review this complete package?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

acceptance. Never cite forecasts to the supplier. A predicted match never makes an offer
eligible. Protocol, authorized execution controls and evidence validation always take
priority. Abstained or unsupported estimates provide no decision evidence. Historical
validation errors are descriptive, not confidence intervals. Candidate forecasts use
neutral placeholder wording and do not evaluate your actual email or evidence. Do not
transfer a forecast to an amended package. A low risk estimate cannot override finality.

flag records historical source delivery; those attachments have not been sent now.

proposal.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your revised quotation, and for taking the 5% deadband into the structure. We now share the full framework: 36 months, 30 days net, and AS-14404 on a 45% material share with a 5% deadband and base month 2026-08. The only open point is the starting price.

We propose one complete package:

- Unit price: EUR 5.04/kg
- Payment: 30 days net
- Contract term: 36 months
- Price adjustment: AS-14404, material share 45%, 5% deadband, base month 2026-08

We are moving from EUR 5.00 to EUR 5.04/kg. Our authorised 23,700 kg per year stays committed for the full three years.

On the alloy side, AS-14404 changed by -5.49% from June to September 2026 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09). We fully recognise that this recent movement sits alongside the annual increase you describe. Under the clause, alloy movements beyond the deadband will continue to adjust the price in both directions over the term. The starting price therefore does not need to carry a forecast of where alloy goes next.

The enquiry terms remain unchanged: 23,700 kg per year, DAP, 14-day lead time, prices valid from 1 January 2027, and no tooling. The commitment involves no additional volume, exclusivity or monthly call-off schedule.

Could you issue this complete package as your binding quotation? If something still stands in the way, please tell me exactly what. I would like to close this with you on a basis that works for both sides over the next three years.

Kind regards,
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your reply and for agreeing to the call. We would be glad to take up the walk-through of your calculation. Could you suggest two or three time slots? If it is easier, a short split of your price into material and conversion (as of base month 2026-08) by e-mail would serve the same purpose.

We understand that €5.60 is the rate you see for these conditions. Please also consider what has changed on our side since your first Angebot:
- We have accepted the AS-14404 Preisgleitklausel. From the 2026-08 base month onwards, you carry no further alloy risk.
- We have doubled the term from 12 to 24 months. That gives you secured volume of 47,400 kg.
- We have kept the 60-day Zahlungsziel.

Because the alloy risk now sits with the clause, the base price should reflect that. To meet you, we are moving up again and offering three alternatives. All are DAP, 14 days lead time, 23,700 kg per year and effective 1 January 2027:

| Package | Price | Zahlungsziel | Term | Index clause (AS-14404, 45% material share, base 2026-08) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A | €5.50/kg | 60 days | 24 months | 5% deadband |
| B | €5.45/kg | 60 days | 24 months | 3% deadband (your structure) |
| C | €5.46/kg | 60 days | 36 months | 5% deadband |

- **Package A** is within 2% of your current figure. We understand it could therefore be settled without waiting for your pricing committee.
- **Package B** keeps exactly the clause you proposed.
- **Package C** gives you three years of volume security, which we understand matters to you as you focus on customers with volume.

Could you let us know which package you can confirm, or which one you would like to finalise on the call? We would like to close this well before the current contract ends on 31 December 2026.

Kind regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for building on Option A. We appreciate your team keeping the 36-month term, the AS-14404 clause with a 5% deadband and the 30-day payment, and the movement you have made on price.

Since we now seem aligned on the structure, the remaining difference is the price. For your review, AS-14404 changed by -5.49% from 2026-06 to 2026-09 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06, idx:AS-14404@2026-09). We recognise that this recent window can coexist with the annual increase you described. The proposed clause would continue to reflect AS-14404 movements beyond the deadband over the contract term.

Could you kindly review whether you can approve Option A as your binding offer? Option A is EUR 5.07/kg, payment within 30 days net, a 36-month contract, AS-14404 on a 45% material share, 5% deadband and base month 2026-08. The fixed terms of our enquiry stay unchanged. If the price is what prevents approval, could your pricing committee review this complete package?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
